## Sheet: BatteryMeasurements

Hybrid Batteries Deemed Acceptable								Conclusions:  As the inner diameter of the receptacle pin gets smaller, toward .273, engagement of the plug gets very stiff and unacceptable. If the inner diameter of the recptalce pin hovers at .275, the engagement of the plug gets acceptable. The root cause of this entire problem is low values for the inner diameter of the receptacle pins. A diameter, measured with a pin gage, of .273 or less will cause the problem.
	SN	ID-1	ID-2	ID-3	ID-4	Notes
